ge.wd1: English Expat Comedy Night, a free community choir, the Nuit des Bains opening and Vevey English comedy on Thursday; rain likely Wednesday and Thursday.
ge.we1: Social Roulette on Friday, the final weekend of Les Automnales, the Plainpalais flea market and the year's last Terra 17 brocante on Saturday, and a makers' market at Usine Kugler on Sunday; rain likely Friday and Sunday.
ge.wd2: F*ck the Small Talk on Monday, English comedy on Tuesday and Wednesday, and Noël au Quai's opening plus Drink, Paint & Meet on Thursday; rain likely most days.
ge.we2: Lausanne's Bô Noël opens, the Garderobes slow-fashion fair in Carouge, the Plainpalais flea market, Drink and Draw and pre-Christmas vide-greniers; rain likely Friday.

zh.wd1: Comedy Brew and Thursday open-mic stand-up, Paint & Cake and the last day of Expovina on Thursday; rain likely Wednesday and Thursday.
zh.we1: Crowd Control English comedy on Friday, Art Meetup Zurich and the Räbechilbi lantern parade on Saturday, Sketch Circle and pottery workshops on Sunday; rain likely Friday and Sunday.
zh.wd2: A beginners' pottery course on Monday, Kon-Tiki comedy on Tuesday, a mixed-media workshop on Wednesday and Zurich's Christmas markets opening on Thursday; rain likely most days.
zh.we2: Blickfang design fair at the Kongresshaus, all the city's Christmas markets, a Craft Brunch and a street-art tour; rain likely Friday.

picks.why: Easy CHF 5 social night with games and language exchange; ideal if you're new and coming alone.
A friendly English-language philosophy chat at the House of Rousseau; good conversation, new faces.
Last weekend of Geneva's big autumn fair: food festival, wine fair and shopping, all indoors.
Makers' market at Usine Kugler: ceramics, prints and handmade gifts, indoors on a rainy Sunday.
Skip the chit-chat: a guided evening of deeper conversations with strangers, made for meeting people.
English comedy and music at El Catrín with Canadian songwriter Craig Cardiff.
Paint your own tote bag over a drink: a creative after-work that makes chatting easy.
Opening night of Geneva's lakeside Christmas market; mulled wine by the water.
Improvised English crowdwork comedy in Oerlikon, a cosy indoor plan for a rainy Friday.
31 artists bring their studios to one hall: meet them, watch them work and buy original art.
Thousands of glowing carved-turnip lanterns in Richterswil, Europe's biggest Räbechilbi.
Bring a sketchbook and draw with others at Art Meetup Zurich; relaxed, indoor and sociable.
Start a four-week beginners' pottery course and get your hands in clay after work.
Zurich's longest-running weekly English stand-up night, at the Kon-Tiki bar in the Niederdorf.
Play with colours, shapes and materials in a guided mixed-media art workshop.
Zurich's Christmas markets open; Polarzauber in the main station stays dry when it rains.

a-ge-123-atelier-croquez-monsieur-madame.desc: An afternoon of life drawing with two models posing in timed sessions; bring your own materials. Friendly and open to all levels.

a-ge-social-roulette-gene-ve-chf-5-11-13.desc: A CHF 5 social evening at CornerPub: make friends, swap languages and play optional games. Easy to join on your own.

a-ge-marche-des-cre-atrices-et-des-cre-a.desc: A makers' market at Usine Kugler, Geneva's former factory turned artists' studios: ceramics, prints, jewellery and handmade gifts from local creators.

a-ge-f-ck-the-small-talk-geneva-15-11-16.desc: A guided evening of deeper conversations with strangers, using question cards to skip the small talk. Ages 22–49; a paid ticket is required.

a-ge-the-comedy-line-presents-craig-card.desc: An evening of music and English comedy at El Catrín with award-winning Canadian singer-songwriter Craig Cardiff and comedian Jenna Clarke.

a-ge-drink-paint-and-meet-peoples-11-19.desc: A creative after-work: paint your own tote bag over a drink and meet new people. Materials provided.

a-zh-art-meetup-zurich-2026-11-14.desc: 31 artists bring their studios into one hall at Villa Bimbam: watch them work, talk to them and buy original pieces.

a-zh-sketch-circle-zurich-art-meetup-zur.desc: Sketch Circle Zurich draws together at Art Meetup Zurich. Bring a sketchbook; all levels welcome.

a-zh-crowd-control-zurich-s-english-crow.desc: Zurich's improvised English comedy show built on crowdwork: comedians riff with the audience rather than reading set jokes.

a-zh-learn-the-basics-of-pottery-beginne.desc: A four-week beginners' pottery course at Ceramics on Wheels: learn hand-building and wheel basics and take your pieces home.

a-zh-atelier-workshop-mischtechnik-11-18.desc: A guided mixed-media art workshop at KreativWerkstatt: experiment freely with colours, shapes and materials. Registration required.

a-zh-comedy-brew-english-stand-up-two-mi.desc: Zurich's weekly English stand-up open mic near Central: about ten comedians a night, from pros testing new jokes to first-timers.

a-ge-brocante-mensuelle-au-coeur-de-gene.desc: The last monthly brocante of the year at Espace Terra 17: vintage finds, books, homeware and curiosities.

a-ge-atelier-fil-11-15.desc: A free crochet workshop at Villa Bernasconi in Lancy: learn the basics or improve your technique with others. Registration recommended.

a-ge-atelier-pictura-espace-du-quartier-.desc: An evening life-drawing session with a model at the Saint-Jean community space; bring your own drawing materials.

a-ge-carousing-in-carouge-11-18.desc: A casual evening meetup for drinks and conversation in Carouge, Geneva's charming old quarter.

a-ge-56e-bourse-aux-mine-raux-fossiles-e.desc: Geneva's 56th minerals, fossils and gems fair: 60 exhibitors with crystals, fossils and natural stone jewellery.

a-ge-mah-pause-cre-ative-11-22.desc: A drop-in creative paper workshop with Superpapier at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, open all afternoon.

a-ge-brocante-11-14.desc: A brocante at the Maison Internationale des Associations: jewellery, vinyl records, books and vintage objects.

a-zh-knit-n-sip-11-17.desc: A relaxed evening of knitting over drinks; bring your project and meet fellow crafters.

a-zh-weekend-start-james-joyce-lollipop-.desc: Kick off the weekend with drinks at the James Joyce pub, then head on to the Lollipop party.

a-ge-oce-ans-re-pe-tition-publique-avec-.desc: The Grand Théâtre de Genève Ballet opens a rehearsal of its new piece to the public at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices.

a-ge-vide-grenier-11-22.desc: A pre-Christmas car-boot-style sale run by the Val d'Arve women's club, with crêpes, cakes and sandwiches on sale.

a-ge-festival-celtiques-entre-ecosse-et-.desc: Celtic music, song and dance from Scotland and Galicia, part of Geneva's Celtic festival.

a-ge-we-love-vinyl-11-14.desc: A vinyl record fair at Le Brise Glace with rare grooves, a talk and surprises; for crate-diggers and music lovers.

a-ge-atelier-de-reliure-artisanale-11-14.desc: A hands-on bookbinding workshop at the Grands-Hutins library: make your own handmade notebook.

a-zh-blotter-art-kevin-barron-uk-11-14.desc: An exhibition of visionary art by British artist Kevin Barron at the Photobastei.

add.title: Les Automnales — Geneva's autumn fair
add.desc: Geneva's big ten-day autumn fair: a food festival with bars and food trucks, the Arvinis wine fair, a shopping market and an upcycling area; open late on Fri and Sat.

add.title: Expovina — wine ships on Lake Zurich
add.desc: A Zurich classic: ships moored at Bürkliplatz become a floating wine fair with thousands of wines to taste; a fun after-work outing with friends.

add.title: Räbechilbi Richterswil — turnip lantern parade
add.desc: Thousands of carved turnip lanterns light up Richterswil's old village in Europe's biggest turnip lantern parade, with a market and music from 15:00. A festival badge (CHF 10, cash) is required; no dogs or strollers.

add.title: Blickfang Zürich — design fair
add.desc: Independent design fair at the Kongresshaus: furniture, jewellery, fashion and homeware sold directly by the designers who make them.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Thu 24 Dec · daily from 11:00/12:00
add.title: Noël au Quai — Geneva's lakeside Christmas market
add.desc: Geneva's big Christmas market on the lakefront: wooden chalets, street food, a fondue chalet, a Christmas pub and a carousel. Opens 19 Nov from 17:00.

add.title: Montreux Noël — Christmas market on the lake
add.desc: One of Switzerland's best-known Christmas markets, with over 150 chalets along the lakefront, a flying Santa and extra stalls up at Château de Chillon and Rochers-de-Naye.

add.when: Weekends from Sat 7 Nov · Sat 12:00–20:00, Sun 10:00–18:00
add.title: Uetliberger Weihnachtsmarkt — Christmas market on Zurich's mountain
add.desc: Weekend-only Christmas market at the top of the Uetliberg, with craft stalls, mulled wine and views over the city; easy to combine with a short walk.

add.title: Polarzauber — Christmas market in Zürich HB
add.desc: One of Europe's biggest indoor Christmas markets fills the main station hall around a giant decorated tree, with gift stalls, food and bars.

add.title: Bellevue Noël — Christmas village on Sechseläutenplatz
add.desc: The new name for the old Wienachtsdorf: a Christmas village in front of the Opera House with craft chalets, food, a fondue chalet and a bar open late.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Münsterhof
add.desc: A smaller, pretty Christmas market on the square by the Fraumünster church, with gifts, crafts and mulled wine.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Wed 23 Dec · weekdays from 16:00, weekends from 13:00
add.title: Singing Christmas Tree & market, Werdmühleplatz
add.desc: Choirs sing from a giant tree-shaped stage several times a day, surrounded by a small market and a fondue chalet.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Dörfli in the Niederdorf
add.desc: Christmas stalls along the cobbled old-town lanes of the Niederdorf, good for small gifts and a stroll.

add.title: Zürcher Weihnachtsallee at Europaallee
add.desc: A Christmas avenue next to the main station with chalets, a Glühstube and a fondue chalet; opens 19 Nov at 16:00.

add.title: Garderobes — slow fashion fair
add.place: Salle des Fêtes de Carouge, Carouge
add.desc: Third edition of Geneva's sustainable fashion fair: second-hand and local designer clothing, repair and upcycling ideas, all under one roof.

add.title: Lancy Christmas market
add.desc: A small, friendly Christmas market next to Lancy-Pont-Rouge station, with evening opening on weekdays for an after-work mulled wine.

add.title: Bô Noël — Lausanne's Christmas markets
add.place: Place Saint-François, Flon and old town, Lausanne
add.desc: Lausanne's festive season: Christmas markets, light installations and bars spread across several squares in the city centre.

add.title: Basler Weihnachtsmarkt — Basel Christmas market
add.desc: One of Switzerland's most beautiful Christmas markets, spread over two old-town squares with crafts, food stalls and a festive atmosphere.

add.when: Thu 26 Nov – Wed 23 Dec · Mon–Thu 11:00–20:00, Fri–Sat to 20:30, Sun to 19:00
add.title: Winterthurer Weihnachtsmarkt
add.desc: Christmas market in Winterthur's car-free old town, five minutes' walk from the station; crafts, mulled wine and festive lights.

add.title: Winterthurer Wintermarkt
add.desc: A relaxed winter market with food, drinks and fire pits, open late on weekday evenings; cashless payment only.
